rules.description: At least three UDP/5014 frames contain DV1 marker bytes.
A UDP/5015 frame contains DATA1 marker bytes; verify forwarding hops separately.
A POISON/SPLITH marker is present in UDP/5014 payload; inspect recipient, metric and routing effect separately.
ICMP or UDP/5015 frames are present; correlate an end-to-end request and result.

manual_checks: R1: Decode sender, destination and metric according to E1.
R2 R4: Correlate each hop and the destination result with the routing table.
R3: Inspect destination, recipient and metric: distinguish route poisoning from poison reverse and prove the resulting route changes.
